question: Where was the United Nations Troop Contributing Countries’ (UNTCC) Chiefs’ Conclave held in October 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• This high-level meeting brought together the **Chiefs of Defence** and senior military leadership from major nations that provide personnel to **United Nations Peacekeeping Operations (UNPKOs)**.

• Participants focused on enhancing **synergy and interoperability** among different national contingents to ensure the effective implementation of **UN mandates**.
